original_test_intent: Verify that every NVIDIA GPU visible to the intended SUT reports the approved model name and that the visible device count matches the platform inventory.
original_method: Verify SUT and driver identity; capture driver/tool version and a stable UUID/BDF/index map; run the exact source gpu_name CSV query read-only; bind each output row to stable identity; compare count and normalized exact model strings with the approved recipe; preserve stdout/stderr/exit/timestamps and health deltas without changing GPU state.
manual_activity: Engineer supplies or approves the expected GPU count/name/identity map and owns the DUT verdict; collection and deterministic comparison need no manual action.
required_inputs: Approved expected GPU count and exact model-name/alias list
Approved local or authenticated remote execution channel
safety_requirements: Use only read-only nvidia-smi inventory queries
Do not embed credentials or disable host-key verification
Do not infer slot identity from output order or identical names
Preserve query failure/missing-device evidence; do not reset GPUs or reload drivers
Do not clear logs or auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Validate host, driver/tool and expected-inventory inputs
Collect stable GPU identity and exact source gpu_name output
Compare every observed identity/name and total count deterministically
Report comparison and evidence without setting DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve expected names, aliases, count and physical mapping

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The nvidia-smi property query is applicable, but sshpass and StrictHostKeyChecking=no are rejected and name-only ordering cannot prove physical identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the exact source nvidia-smi --format=csv --query-gpu=gpu_name through an approved channel and correlate a separate read-only UUID/BDF/index inventory in the same evidence set.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: gpu_name, CSV output, all-visible-GPU scope and 30-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create an expected-versus-observed table keyed by UUID/BDF/slot, preserving the literal source query output and device count.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable identity, trusted transport and count validation without replacing the required name query.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents correct duplicate name strings from masking a missing or mis-mapped GPU.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Driver-visible names can use approved aliases, and virtualized or MIG views require explicit project scope.

project_override_considerations: Project recipe must define accepted product-name spelling/aliases and whether virtual functions, MIG instances or intentionally hidden devices are in scope.
expected_evidence: Read-only health/error evidence and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require GPU-name inventory; expected values are a project input, not contradictory source content.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review and read-only collection are possible; absence of the approved expected list only withholds final DUT comparison/verdict.

review_improvement: Makes the original all-GPU name check traceable to stable devices and an explicit expected count while removing insecure transport assumptions.
independent_technical_reasoning: A list of identical product names is insufficient evidence of physical coverage because one missing GPU can be hidden by ordering or repeated models. Correlating the literal name output with UUID/BDF identity and an approved count makes the comparison deterministic; none of those queries require a state change.
